source.decided: 2026-10-03: ink #16131F, purple-tinted greys, Poppins + IBM Plex Mono for codes

tokens.name: brand-purple
tokens.usage: Mole's colour, in every product. Fills: the app's and the Rally's main button (white text 5.27:1), selected states, the stamp field. Not for small text: use brand-purple-text.

tokens.name: brand-purple-hover
tokens.usage: brand-purple pressed or hovered. White text 7.54:1.

tokens.name: brand-purple-tint
tokens.usage: Soft purple: selected rows and tiles, info cards, chips, missing-photo placeholders. Carries brand-purple-text (5.64:1) or ink.

tokens.name: brand-purple-text
tokens.usage: Purple taken dark enough for words, links and outlines: 6.67:1 on white, 6.27:1 on brand-base, 5.64:1 on brand-purple-tint. (brand-purple itself is only 4.46:1 on the tint, which misses AA.)

tokens.name: brand-purple-border
tokens.usage: Borders around brand-purple-tint panels.

tokens.name: brand-yellow
tokens.usage: Sunny's yellow: Sunny, the Mole Card, the logo. As a fill it appears only on dark grounds (board, brand-ink) for something live, with ink on it (14.65:1). Never a button on a light ground, never text.

tokens.name: brand-yellow-tint
tokens.usage: The soft yellow disc or wash behind Sunny.

tokens.name: brand-yellow-text
tokens.usage: Yellow-family text on white (4.89:1) or brand-yellow-tint (4.71:1).

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Mole's one ink, the logo's: text, the main button on public pages and the programme (white text 18.31:1), the dark of the logo.

tokens.name: brand-base
tokens.usage: The page ground of the app and the Rally. Ink on it 17.21:1.

tokens.name: neutral-fg
tokens.usage: Body text and headings. 18.31:1 on white, 17.21:1 on brand-base.

tokens.name: neutral-fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions: 7.59:1 on white, 7.14:1 on brand-base, 6.43:1 on neutral-surface-3, 6.15:1 on rally-deep.

tokens.name: neutral-fg-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: 5.64:1 on white, 5.30:1 on brand-base, 4.77:1 on neutral-surface-3, 4.56:1 on rally-deep, 5.20:1 on loop-ground. Fails on lavender (4.31:1) and admin-tint (4.48:1): use neutral-fg-muted there.

tokens.name: neutral-fg-disabled
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled controls only, never information (3.47:1 on white).

tokens.name: neutral-border
tokens.usage: Dividers, card and input borders: Bingo's purple hairline (line) flattened onto white. Decorative: 1.2:1, so never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: neutral-border-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary button outlines and input borders: line-firm flattened onto white (1.63:1 on white). Below 3:1, kept from the sources: a control must also differ by its fill or label.

tokens.name: neutral-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, modals, the Bingo card's squares.

tokens.name: neutral-surface-2
tokens.usage: Table stripes and inset panels: the base ground, one step down from white.

tokens.name: neutral-surface-3
tokens.usage: Chips, tracks, pressed rows. Text on it is neutral-fg-muted or darker.

tokens.name: neutral-on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a dark fill: brand-purple, brand-ink, admin, the pro gradient.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The one dimmed room behind every sheet, overlay and dialog: ink at 58%.

tokens.name: admin
tokens.usage: Mole Admin (the den). Main button with white text (7.10:1).

tokens.name: admin-tint
tokens.usage: Soft admin backgrounds.

tokens.name: admin-text
tokens.usage: Small admin text on white (7.10:1) or admin-tint (5.64:1).

tokens.name: admin-on
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the admin fill.

tokens.name: loop
tokens.usage: Loop, the B2B product: fills take ink (8.03:1). White on it is 2.28:1 and fails: never.

tokens.name: loop-tint
tokens.usage: Soft Loop backgrounds.

tokens.name: loop-text
tokens.usage: Small Loop text on white (5.28:1) or loop-tint (4.69:1).

tokens.name: loop-on
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the loop fill.

tokens.name: loop-chrome
tokens.usage: The Loop dashboard's sidebar. White on it 15.73:1; the active item in loop green 6.90:1.

tokens.name: loop-ground
tokens.usage: The Loop dashboard's page ground. Ink 16.89:1.

tokens.name: events
tokens.usage: Events: badges, the Events tab, an event header with no accent of its own. Ink on it 10.30:1.

tokens.name: events-tint
tokens.usage: Soft Events backgrounds.

tokens.name: events-text
tokens.usage: Small Events text on white (5.06:1) or events-tint (4.68:1).

tokens.name: events-on
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the events fill.

tokens.name: spaces
tokens.usage: Spaces (buildings): badges and headers. Ink on it 9.35:1.

tokens.name: spaces-tint
tokens.usage: Soft Spaces backgrounds.

tokens.name: spaces-text
tokens.usage: Small Spaces text on white (5.06:1) or spaces-tint (4.61:1).

tokens.name: spaces-on
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the spaces fill.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: The success state's fill: icons, dots, bars. Always with an icon and a word, never colour alone. Ink on it 8.03:1. Shares its green with loop.

tokens.name: status-success-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a success notice.

tokens.name: status-success-text
tokens.usage: Success text on white (5.32:1) or status-success-tint (4.84:1).

tokens.name: status-success-border
tokens.usage: Border of a success notice.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: The warning state's fill: icons, dots, bars. Always with an icon and a word, never colour alone. Ink on it 8.52:1.

tokens.name: status-warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a warning notice.

tokens.name: status-warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning text on white (5.93:1) or status-warning-tint (5.32:1).

tokens.name: status-warning-border
tokens.usage: Border of a warning notice.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: The error state's fill: icons, dots, bars. Always with an icon and a word, never colour alone. Ink on it 4.87:1.

tokens.name: status-error-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a error notice.

tokens.name: status-error-text
tokens.usage: Error text on white (6.54:1) or status-error-tint (5.35:1).

tokens.name: status-error-border
tokens.usage: Border of a error notice.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: The info state's fill: icons, dots, bars. Always with an icon and a word, never colour alone. Ink on it 4.98:1.

tokens.name: status-info-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a info notice.

tokens.name: status-info-text
tokens.usage: Info text on white (5.69:1) or status-info-tint (4.67:1).

tokens.name: status-info-border
tokens.usage: Border of a info notice.

tokens.name: rally
tokens.usage: The Rally's ground, fading to rally-deep. The same colour as brand-base.

tokens.name: rally-deep
tokens.usage: The deep end of the Rally ground gradient. Ink 14.82:1, neutral-fg-muted 6.15:1.

tokens.name: rally-card
tokens.usage: The Bingo card: warm paper. Ink 17.96:1, brand-purple-text 6.54:1.

tokens.name: rally-tile
tokens.usage: A square on the card, and the desk's white panels.

tokens.name: rally-filled
tokens.usage: A stamped square. Ink 17.12:1.

tokens.name: rally-pink
tokens.usage: Graphics only: the stamp badge, its +1 bubble, counters. 3.64:1 on the card, so never text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The purple hairline around the desk's white panels (the Rally's own; neutral-border is the same line on white).

tokens.name: line-firm
tokens.usage: The firmer purple outline: Rally inputs, hovered tiles.

tokens.name: berry
tokens.usage: The far end of the brand gradient (brand-purple to berry). Graphics only.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Soft tint for decorative Rally fields. Ink 13.99:1.

tokens.name: pink-soft
tokens.usage: Soft pink; the far end of the soft gradient. Ink 15.23:1.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Success tint on the Rally. mint-ink on it 5.62:1.

tokens.name: mint-ink
tokens.usage: Success text on the Rally, and the WhatsApp button (white on it 6.49:1).

tokens.name: mint-bright
tokens.usage: Bright success accent in pictures. Ink 9.52:1.

tokens.name: board
tokens.usage: The Board's ground: anything live and read at a distance. board-fg 16.67:1, board-muted 8.80:1, brand-yellow 14.60:1.

tokens.name: board-2
tokens.usage: The Board's raised fields: the door strip, panels. board-fg 14.92:1, board-muted 7.87:1.

tokens.name: board-fg
tokens.usage: Text on board and board-2.

tokens.name: board-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on board and board-2.

tokens.name: board-lilac
tokens.usage: Labels and quiet text on board (11.36:1).

tokens.name: board-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines on the Board.

tokens.name: board-line-firm
tokens.usage: Stronger dividers and outlines on the Board.

tokens.name: board-ok
tokens.usage: Good news on the Board: the word 'Bingo' on a projector (11.38:1).

tokens.name: pink-mid
tokens.usage: The End-session warning on the Board: text and outline (12.11:1).

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Paused and late-clock warnings on the Board (13.51:1).

tokens.name: paper-ground
tokens.usage: The Programme's page ground: printed reports, document pages. Ink 17.24:1, neutral-fg-muted 7.15:1.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Paper surfaces on the Programme.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline rules on the Programme.

tokens.name: rule-firm
tokens.usage: Stronger rules on the Programme.

tokens.name: soil-0
tokens.usage: The Underground's soil, layer 0 from the surface down: the ground band under Sunny on the marketing pages. Ink on it 13.52:1.

tokens.name: soil-1
tokens.usage: The Underground's soil, layer 1 from the surface down.

tokens.name: soil-2
tokens.usage: The Underground's soil, layer 2 from the surface down.

tokens.name: soil-3
tokens.usage: The Underground's soil, layer 3 from the surface down.

tokens.name: soil-4
tokens.usage: The Underground's soil, layer 4 from the surface down.

tokens.name: soil-5
tokens.usage: The Underground's soil, layer 5 from the surface down.

tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: The deepest Underground: the caverns' darkness on the marketing pages. board-fg on it 17.97:1.

tokens.name: sunny-deep
tokens.usage: Sunny's yellow in shadow: the Underground's highlights and edges. Graphics only.

tokens.name: purple-deep
tokens.usage: Purple in shadow: the Underground's depth and the pro gradient's far end. White on it 8.18:1.

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: The public-page and marketing headline (52px from the sm breakpoint). Black (900) is for display sizes only.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The biggest figure on a phone: the lobby's dig timer, an invite code. Digits use tabular figures.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one big thing on a screen: an event, a building, a session name in the Live hero.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Meet people, stamp your card, fill a line.
styles.usage: Running text on marketing pages, and Sunny's speech bubbles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your card was saved by three people this week.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, list rows: text a person acts on.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Pick one that is true about you.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Legal lines and the smallest captions. The floor: nothing anyone reads is under 11px.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels. Typed in sentence case; the style makes it uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Codes, IDs and numbers that must line up: invite codes, card IDs, table figures. Never headings, labels or running text.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: None.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside chips and small panels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the page gutter on a phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Above a page's first heading.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Form fields (Bingo radius-field).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small controls in the app and the den.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The small Button; small chips, tags and swatches (Bingo radius-rally-chip).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The Button in the App, the den and Loop; rail tabs and menus (Bingo radius-rally-tab).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The Bingo card's head strip; large panels in the app (Bingo radius-rally-head).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: chips, avatars and round buttons everywhere; every button on the Rally, the Board, the Programme and the marketing sites (Bingo radius-control).

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Public pages: pills, tags, small avatars.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Public pages: an inset panel; the Bingo card's squares, KPI tiles, notices (Bingo radius-rally-tile).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Public pages: ordinary cards.

tokens.name: radius-rally-panel
tokens.usage: The Rally desk's white panels.

tokens.name: radius-rally-card
tokens.usage: The Bingo card, the Rally sheets and the Live hero.

tokens.name: radius-feature
tokens.usage: Public pages: the statement cards a page is built around.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Public pages: the top curve of the sheet a page sits on.

tokens.name: shadow-subtle
tokens.usage: Resting cards.

tokens.name: shadow-medium
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, menus.

tokens.name: shadow-large
tokens.usage: Sheets and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-elevated
tokens.usage: Modals and the paywall.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: A card lifted off the Rally ground.

tokens.name: shadow-loud
tokens.usage: The Rally's loud purple button, and only that.

zIndex.note: Anything fixed takes one of these layers; small numbers only order things inside one component.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Ordinary content.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus inside a component.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: The bottom nav, sticky bars, the install banner.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Every sheet and full-screen overlay.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Confirm dialogs, which can open over a sheet.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers inside a modal.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.
